text: Planning a trip takes time and effort, but it is always worth it. When I visited Japan last year, I spent weeks researching places to stay and things to see. Experiencing new cultures was the best part—I loved how polite and orderly everything felt. The food was amazing, from fresh sushi to warm bowls of ramen. However, language barriers were tricky at times. I often used hand gestures and translation apps to communicate with locals. Despite this, people were very kind and helpful. Those memories—tasting strange dishes, getting lost in narrow streets, and smiling at strangers—are still vivid in my mind. Travel teaches you so much about the world and yourself.
